dialogue.origin: (こんにちは本日は宜しくお願い致します)
dialogue.content: (Hello. Thank you for coming today.)

dialogue.origin: （よろしくお願いいたします！）
dialogue.content: (Thank you for having me!)

dialogue.origin: (時間前ですが、このままスタートしても大丈夫でしょうか？)
dialogue.content: (We're a little early, but is it alright if we start now?)

dialogue.origin: （はい、大丈夫です）
dialogue.content: (Yes, that's fine.)

dialogue.origin: (ありがとうございますでは始めさせていただきます)
dialogue.content: (Thank you. I'll go ahead and get us started.)

dialogue.origin: こんにちは、相談員です今日はご相談にきてくださりありがとうございますはじめに、年齢と性別、ご相談内容をお聞かせください
dialogue.content: Hello, I'm the counselor. Thank you for coming in for a consultation today. To begin, could you please tell me your age, gender, and what brings you in?

dialogue.origin: ４２歳　女性子どもが学校に行かなくなりました
dialogue.content: I'm a 42-year-old woman. My child has stopped going to school.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね、それはご心配ですよね
dialogue.content: I see. That must be very worrying for you.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: お子さんの年齢と性別もお聞きしてもいいでしょうか？
dialogue.content: May I also ask your child's age and gender?

dialogue.origin: 中2 １４歳　女の子です
dialogue.content: She's in 8th grade, 14 years old, a girl.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございます学校に行かなくなったのは、いつ頃からでしょうか？
dialogue.content: Thank you. When did she stop going to school?

dialogue.origin: ９月です
dialogue.content: Since September.

dialogue.origin: 夏休み終わって
dialogue.content: After the summer break.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね、最近のことなのですねお子さんは、どのようなことで学校に行かない状況なのでしょうか？
dialogue.content: I see, so this is quite recent. What seems to be the reason she's not going to school?

dialogue.origin: それがわからないのです
dialogue.content: That's the thing, I don't know.

dialogue.origin: そうでしたか、わからないとお母様も不安になりますよねお子さんとは、そのことについてどのようなお話をされていますか？
dialogue.content: I understand. It must make you anxious not knowing the reason. What kind of conversations have you had with your daughter about this?

dialogue.origin: 行かない、としか言わず、理由を聞いても、行きたくないからとしか答えてくれません
dialogue.content: She just says, "I'm not going," and when I ask why, her only answer is, "Because I don't want to go."

dialogue.origin: なるほど、行きたくないと答えておられるのですねそれはお子さんもお母さんもしんどいですね
dialogue.content: I see, so she's just saying she doesn't want to go. That must be difficult for both you and your daughter.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 下に、小5の息子がいて、姉ちゃんだけずるいと言い出し、それもどうしたら良いか
dialogue.content: I also have a son in the 5th grade, and he's started saying it's not fair that his older sister gets to stay home. I don't know what to do about that either.

dialogue.origin: そうだったんですね、下のお子さんの事も対応しないといけないのはとてもキツいですよね
dialogue.content: I see. Having to deal with your younger child's reaction on top of everything else must be very tough.

dialogue.origin: そうですね
dialogue.content: Yes, it is.

dialogue.origin: お嬢さんは、一学期はどのような様子で学校に行ってましたか？
dialogue.content: What was your daughter like when she was going to school during the first semester?

dialogue.origin: 特に変わった様子もなく、休むこともありませんでした
dialogue.content: She seemed completely normal, and she never missed a day.

dialogue.origin: なるほど、では２学期が始まって急に起こったということなのですねそれは突然のことで、混乱していまいますよね
dialogue.content: I see. So this happened suddenly right after the second semester started. That must be very confusing for you.

dialogue.origin: そうなのです何かあるなら話してくれれば良いのですけど
dialogue.content: Exactly. I wish she would just tell me if something is wrong.

dialogue.origin: ええ、そうですよね、せめて理由が分かれば対応を考えたりということもできますよね
dialogue.content: Yes, I understand. If you at least knew the reason, you could think about how to handle it.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: では、お嬢さん、夏休みはどのようにお過ごしでしたか？
dialogue.content: So, how did your daughter spend her summer vacation?

dialogue.origin: 高校受験を考えているので、塾に行ったり…
dialogue.content: She's thinking about high school entrance exams, so she was going to cram school and the like...

dialogue.origin: 塾に行ったりされてたんですね睡眠時間や睡眠のリズムも特に変わらずでしたでしょうか？例えば、学校のあるときより、夜遅くまで起きていたとか、、、
dialogue.content: She was attending cram school, I see. Were there any changes to her sleep schedule or rhythm? For example, staying up later at night than when she had school?

dialogue.origin: 多少、夜は遅かったかもしれません塾の夏期講習は午前中で、それには通ってました
dialogue.content: She might have been staying up a bit later. The summer intensive classes at the cram school were in the morning, and she did attend those.

dialogue.origin: なるほど、夏期講習にも参加して頑張っておられてたのですね
dialogue.content: I see. So she was working hard, even attending the summer session.

dialogue.origin: はい親の私から見ても、よく頑張っていたと思います
dialogue.content: Yes. From my perspective as her parent, I think she was working very hard.

dialogue.origin: そうですよね、中学二年生から高校受験のために頑張るというのはなかなか出来る事じゃないと思います
dialogue.content: That's right. It's impressive for an 8th grader to start working towards high school exams like that.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: では、１学期も休まず学校に行っておられて、夏休みも塾の夏期講習にも通われて、変わった様子もなくおすごしだったということですね
dialogue.content: So she attended school without absences in the first term, went to the cram school's summer courses, and there were no particular changes in how she spent her time—does that sound right?

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: ひとつ気になるとすれば、友だちの話が出なくなっていたことです
dialogue.content: If there's one thing that concerns me, it's that she stopped talking about her friends.

dialogue.origin: なるほど、それをお母様が気付いたのはいつ頃ですか？
dialogue.content: I see. When did you notice that?

dialogue.origin: 夏休みですふつう、夏休みになったら、友だちと遊びに行くのではと
dialogue.content: During the summer break. Normally, I would expect her to go out and spend time with friends.

dialogue.origin: そうでしたか夏休みに塾へは行かれていたけれど、お友達と遊びに行ったりしていなかったのですねそれは気になりますよね
dialogue.content: I see. So even though she was going to cram school during the summer, she wasn't going out to play with her friends. That is concerning.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: お嬢さんのお友達というのは、どういった関係のお友達が主ですか？クラスメイトが多いとか、部活のお友達が多いなど。
dialogue.content: What kind of friendships does your daughter mainly have? Are they mostly classmates, or friends from her school club?

dialogue.origin: もともと友だちが多い方ではないと思うのですがクラスメイトのお友だち何人かと、仲良くしている様子でした
dialogue.content: I don't think she's ever been the type to have a lot of friends, but she seemed to be on good terms with a few of her classmates.

dialogue.origin: なるほど、では１学期はクラスにはお友達と仲良くしていたのですね学校の先生は、学校での様子で何かおっしゃっておられましたか？
dialogue.content: I see, so in the first term she was getting along with friends in her class. Have her teachers mentioned anything about how she is at school?

dialogue.origin: いえ、特に…問題のない子で、勉強も良く頑張っていますねと
dialogue.content: No, not particularly... Just that she's a good student with no problems and that she studies hard.

dialogue.origin: そうでしたか、では先生も気になることがないということなのですね今回のこと、どなたかに相談されたりはしておられますか？
dialogue.content: I see. So the teacher hasn't noticed anything concerning either. Have you consulted with anyone else about this?

dialogue.origin: まだ日が浅いので、誰にも相談していません。主人は、そっとしておけと、言っていますが、まだ、いまなら、と思う気持ちが、わたしにはあります
dialogue.content: It hasn't been long, so I haven't spoken to anyone. My husband says to just leave her be, but I feel that if we act now, we might still be able to do something.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね、まだ２学期が始まって間もないし、長く休んで行き難くならないうちにとお母様が思案される気持ちよく分かります
dialogue.content: I understand. The second semester has just started, and it's perfectly understandable that you're worried and want to address this before it becomes a long-term absence and harder for her to go back.

dialogue.origin: 私がひとり焦っているのでしょうか
dialogue.content: Am I the only one getting anxious about this?

dialogue.origin: お子さんのことを思っての事ですので、お母様が焦りを感じるお気持ちは自然な事だと思います。
dialogue.content: You're thinking about what's best for your child, so it's only natural for you to feel a sense of urgency.

dialogue.origin: 子どもに、友達のこと、聞いてみた方が良いですか？
dialogue.content: Should I try asking her about her friends?

dialogue.origin: 何か友達のことでお母さんに聞いて欲しいことがあるか聞いてみても良いかも知れません言いたいことはいつでも聴くからね、というメッセージを伝えるのは大事だと思いますただ言いたくない様子でしたら、無理には聞き出さなくても大丈夫だと思います
dialogue.content: You could ask if there's anything about her friends that she wants to talk to you about. I think it's important to convey the message, 'I'm here to listen whenever you're ready.' If she doesn't seem willing to talk, it's okay not to press her.

dialogue.origin: わかりました
dialogue.content: I understand.

dialogue.origin: 今、お子さんはおうちではどのような様子ですか？
dialogue.content: How is your daughter at home right now?

dialogue.origin: ごはんのとき以外は、ほぼ自分の部屋にいます
dialogue.content: Except for mealtimes, she's almost always in her room.

dialogue.origin: そうでしたか、お母さんの作ったお食事は食べておられるのですねお子さんの好きな事や興味のあることなどなにかありますか？
dialogue.content: I see. So she does eat the meals you prepare for her. Does she have any hobbies or things she's interested in?

dialogue.origin: はい、食事はしています好きなこと…Kpop？私が疎くて、よくわからないのですが
dialogue.content: Yes, she is eating. Things she likes... K-pop? I'm not very familiar with it, so I don't really know.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね、ではそのお話をお食事の時にしてみたり、お子さんが少しでも家族と過ごしているときに楽しいと思えるような関わりをしてさしあげるといいかもしれませんね
dialogue.content: I see. Well, perhaps you could try talking about that during meals, or find ways to interact with her so that the time she spends with family is a little more enjoyable for her.

dialogue.origin: そうか、そうですよね子どもの好きなこともよくわからないなんて
dialogue.content: Oh, you're right. To think I don't even know what my own child likes...

dialogue.origin: 他に何かお母様が今おうちでお子さんのためにできそうだなと思われること、何かありますか？
dialogue.content: Is there anything else you can think of that you could do for your daughter at home right now?

dialogue.origin: 犬を飼う、とかは、よくないでしょうか家から出たくなくなってしまいますか
dialogue.content: Would getting a dog be a bad idea? Would it make her not want to leave the house?

dialogue.origin: はい、いいですねおうちで穏やかに過ごしているうちに、気持ちが変わるかもしれないし、行きたくないままでも理由を話す気になるかもしれません
dialogue.content: Yes, that sounds like a good idea. While spending time peacefully at home, her feelings might change, or even if she still doesn't want to go to school, she might feel more like talking about the reason why.

dialogue.origin: 以前からずっと、子どもたちに飼いたいと言われているのですけど、私がお世話することになるだろうから、ダメと言ってきたのです
dialogue.content: My children have been asking for a dog for a long time, but I've always said no because I knew I would be the one taking care of it.

dialogue.origin: そうでしたか、お世話をきちんとする約束ができるなら考えてみてもいいかもしれませんねそのあたりをご家族でまた話し合ってみてくださいませ
dialogue.content: I see. Well, if they can promise to take proper care of it, it might be something to consider. Please try discussing it again with your family.

dialogue.origin: わかりました
dialogue.content: I understand.

dialogue.origin: また今後必要に応じて学校の先生との連携も取りながら、お一人で抱えず、お子さんのお気持ちも大切にしながらお過ごしください
dialogue.content: Going forward, please coordinate with her teachers as needed, and try not to carry this burden alone. Please continue to be mindful of your daughter's feelings as well.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 本日はお時間になりましたが、お話になりたいことは話せましたでしょうか？
dialogue.content: Our time is up for today. Were you able to talk about everything you wanted to discuss?

dialogue.origin: はい、大丈夫ですありがとうございました
dialogue.content: Yes, that's fine. Thank you very much.

dialogue.origin: はい、ありがとうございましたではまた何かご相談がございましたら、お越しください本日はご相談ありがとうございました
dialogue.content: Thank you as well. If there's anything else you'd like to discuss, please feel free to come again. Thank you for your consultation today.

dialogue.origin: (ありがとうございました後ほど評価を宜しくお願い致します)
dialogue.content: (Thank you very much. I'd appreciate your feedback later.)
